paragraphs.quote: Don't mistake me for just another old lady. I once served and attended to the Lady Guuji herself...

paragraphs.heading: 여담

paragraphs.note: All supported: A17-A18 give the quote and the laugh.
paragraphs.quote: Hahaha, you praise me excessively. Right now, I'm nothing more than a servant of the Kamisato Clan.
